asA: stage-keeper opening a fix round on a spec already complete
iWant: a bundle that names only the criteria the round touches
soThat: an 8-criterion fix on a 152-criterion spec stays an 8-criterion round through REVIEW, TEST and Finalise
title: The stage-keeper bundles an amend round on a complete or verified spec, scoped to the touched criteria

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture FBS-001 at complete scoping AC-101-1 to AC-101-6 and a green base-suite record, when rcf build bundle FBS-001 --acs AC-101-2,AC-101-5 --base-suite <file> --format json runs, then it exits 0, the json carries "round": "amend" and "touchedAcIds": ["AC-101-2", "AC-101-5"] and lists only those two criteria with their test cases and Code Nodes; with --format md the title reads "Amend round on FBS-001: 2 criteria" and the runbook's first stage is DEFINE.

[failure] Given FBS-002 at inProgress, rcf build bundle FBS-002 --acs AC-102-1 --base-suite <file> exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage --acs scopes an amend round on a complete or verified spec"; given --acs AC-999-1 on FBS-001 it exits 3 with "[error] brokenReference AC-999-1 is not scoped by FBS-001"; given a retired AC-101-6 whose successor is AC-101-7 it exits 2 with "[error] usage AC-101-6 is retired; amend its successor AC-101-7".

[edge] Given FBS-001 at verified, the amend bundle is emitted the same way; given --next with --acs, the verb exits 2; and rcf build bundle --next over a tree whose only remaining specs are complete or verified prints "Next actionable: none" and never selects an amend round.

[must-not] An amend bundle never lists a criterion outside --acs and never changes any FBS executionStatus: the md and json output name no other criterion of FBS-001, and every rcf/fbs/ file is byte-identical after the run.

[non-functional] Given a fixture spec of 152 criteria at complete (the redesign's heavy round) and --acs naming 8 of them, the amend bundle's json lists 8 criteria and its size is no more than 1.2 times that of an amend bundle naming 8 criteria of a 10-criterion spec, so output scales with the touched criteria, not the spec.
